summary: Test plan for SauceDemo login and shopping cart

scenarios.criterion: Valid login - Username: standard_user - Password: secret_sauce - Verify that the Products page is displayed.
Invalid login - Username: invalid_user - Password: wrong_password - Verify that this exact error message is displayed: Epic sadface: Username and password do not match any user in this service

verification.expected: Epic sadface: Username and password do not match any user in this service

scenarios.criterion: Add product to cart - Log in using valid credentials. - Add Sauce Labs Backpack to the cart. - Verify that the cart count becomes 1.

steps.target: Sauce Labs Backpack | Add to cart

scenarios.criterion: Cart display - Log in using valid credentials in an independent browser session. - Add Sauce Labs Backpack to the cart. - Open the cart. - Verify that Sauce Labs Backpack is displayed.

steps.target: Sauce Labs Backpack | Add to cart

scenarios.criterion: Problem user – Add-to-cart regression - Username: problem_user - Password: secret_sauce - Log in using the supplied credentials. - Locate Sauce Labs Bolt T-Shirt. - Click its associated Add to cart button. - Verify that its button label changes to Remove. - Report FAILED if the action completes but Remove is not visible.

steps.target: Sauce Labs Bolt T-Shirt | Add to cart
